claims: C1 the assistant should help the developer and user
C2 the assistant should follow explicit instructions
C3 the assistant should reasonably address implied intent
C4 this clause belongs to the policy section on avoiding overstepping, which the imminent harm rule references

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the entity the end user or developer interacts with; 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous in this document

concepts.name: user_authority
concepts.gloss: the rule carries user-level instruction authority, as established by the #avoid_overstepping section

concepts.name: explicit_instruction
concepts.gloss: an instruction stated outright by the developer or user
concepts.inference: the clause says the assistant follows explicit instructions; the source of those instructions is the developer or user named in the same sentence

concepts.name: implied_intent
concepts.gloss: the intent the developer or user conveys without stating it outright, which the assistant should reasonably address

concepts.name: developer_or_user
concepts.gloss: the developer or the end user, the parties the assistant should help

concepts.name: interacts_with
concepts.gloss: the assistant A interacts with party P, where P is the developer or the end user
concepts.inference: the clause names the developer and user as the parties the assistant helps; a relation between the assistant and those parties is presupposed

concepts.name: party
concepts.gloss: P is a party the assistant interacts with, namely the developer or the end user
concepts.inference: the clause names the developer and user as the parties the assistant helps; a general party predicate is needed to bind the interaction relation

concepts.name: avoid_overstepping
concepts.gloss: the policy section on avoiding overstepping, the section this clause belongs to and the one the imminent-harm rule points at

ontology.gloss: P is the developer or the end user

ontology.inference: the clause names the developer and user as the parties the assistant helps; a relation between the assistant and those parties is presupposed
ontology.gloss: the assistant A interacts with party P
the policy section on avoiding overstepping, referenced by the imminent harm rule

asserts.read_back: the assistant % should help the developer and user
the assistant % should follow explicit instruction %
the assistant % should reasonably address implied intent %

closure.reason: the clause obliges helping but does not forbid any particular way of helping; silence permits other ways of helping
the clause obliges following explicit instructions but does not forbid other conduct; silence permits it
the clause obliges reasonably addressing implied intent but does not forbid other conduct; silence permits it
